title: Kafka west scale-out: drain + rejoin a broker
description: scale-out remove drains a broker (quorum-majority guarded); scale-out add --role broker rejoins it (lag 0).

prerequisites.smokeGate: nexus-infra-kafka smoke-0.H.2 + smoke-0.H.5 ALL GREEN; role-overlay-kafka-acl-authorizer applied

observe.what: the broker is drained; a paired scale-out add rejoins it caught-up

whatProves: scale-out covers broker drain/rejoin against the fixed 3-node combined quorum.
